title: Gary Nolan's strontium UFO metamaterial sample

tellings.quote: isn't strontium I believe is one of Gary Nolan's pieces that he has at the you know Stanford lab that he thinks might be UFO metamaterials that come from crashes I believe has strontium in it

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he believes that Garry Nolan, a scientist at Stanford University, keeps pieces of material in his lab that Nolan thinks could be UFO "metamaterials". These are specially engineered materials that Nolan suspects come from crashed craft. Michels says, with some hesitation, that one of the pieces contains strontium, a metallic chemical element.
